verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a dedicated driveItem delta endpoint that tracks changes to a driveItem and its children over time. The delta query overview confirms it lets apps discover created, updated, or deleted entities without a full read of the resource on every request, which is exactly the incremental-sync behavior the story asks for. Missing for 10: the excerpts do not detail the cursor/token mechanics (e.g., how the delta link or token is persisted and resumed), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the delta API.
